Carmen: Quick capture from onboarding calls today — sending compressed signals for product triage. Recurring asks: per-route cost exports, printable onboarding checklist, embedding freshness alerts, and one SSO mapping that's a renewal risk.
Theo: Can you flag which one is blocking renewal?
Carmen: Horizon Health SSO is blocking renewal (P0). Details: IdP sends 'uid' while our mapping expects 'email' -> 401 on login. CRM notes updated.
Ravi: I'll take per-route cost. Proposal: daily CSV with fields route_id, route_label, tokens_in, tokens_out, model, cost_est_usd, date. I'll sketch API contract in PROD-2111.
Lina: I'll own the printable onboarding checklist doc and add a JSON schema so DevEx can auto-fill customer info. ETA Tue.
Theo: Embedding freshness: two customers saw >48h lag on batch re-ingest. We should show a "last indexed" timestamp and a staleness warning in Console. I can spike and return numbers.
Carmen: Added small CSV excerpt to shared drive and marked Horizon as blocking_renewal.
triage-bot: Created ticket CS-1122 "SSO attr mismatch - horizon-21" and linked to thread.
Ravi: I'll open PROD-2111 for route-cost spike and include sample SQL to count tokens per route.
Theo: For Horizon, Carmen please paste IdP trace here or DM eng-oncall so we can triage within 48h.
Carmen: Pasted IdP snippet and CRM link. Escalating to eng-oncall now.
Lina: Once checklist PR is up I'll link it in Help Center and add a short playbook for common IdP mappings.
Carmen: I'll consolidate rows into the product intake sheet with rubric columns: blocking_renewal, customers_affected, suggested_owner. Posting summary to Monday triage. Thanks all :pray:
